text: Delivered in merge 2382e56 (branch commit ddf88cf); main's tree equals the branch tree be18c96. tools/study-consumer now qualifies all three contracts (execution, serialization, inspection) for the fixation, recording and temporal routes, including the consumer's custom comparison and custom detector, entirely through published APIs: discovery, preflight, RecordingExecution/TemporalExecution/StudyExecution with progress and cancellation, inspection with coded source-linked diagnostics, manifests with the new roles, fresh-process reload in a separate JVM whose classpath is checked jar by jar against the local publish, bit-exact rerun on the JVM, value identity on Scala.js; published ExecutionLaws and ManifestLaws run over six consumer routes; failure paths per route (missing/changed artifact, unknown extension, invalid geometry, cancelled run, stale revision, failed pair or failed synchronization) asserted as exact outcomes; receipt with source revision, artifact and fixture SHA-256s, runtime, gates and a reported response envelope (fixtures under 1 ms per step; 256x256 sigma 32 at 19.1 ms; 10 s recording at 10.0 ms). Library fix: RecipeDescriptors.temporal reports the base study's execution capability (tested both directions). Documented limits in the consumer README, EXTENDING_STUDIES.md and the plan's G1 outcome. Builder's fresh-context review: no blockers, six should-fixes applied. Verified on main: verify.py full publish 192 JVM / 181 JS; root 3,523.
